newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwoon Chung IPO seen 50 times subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: Kwoon Chung IPO seen 50 times subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares in Hong Kong-based bus line operator Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd was seen over 50 times subscribed at the close of the offer at noon on Wednesday, market sources said.
An official statement on the subscription results will be made on Friday. Dealing in shares is expected to commence on September 25.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd is the sponsor and underwriter of the new issue.

Kwoon Chung plans to issue 59 million new shares at HK$1.80 per share, raising net proceeds of HK$93 million to expand its bus-related business in Hong Kong and in China, and to reduce bank borrowing.
Kwoon Chung provides non-franchised bus services on Hong Kong Island and franchised buses on Lantau Island.
